Spacecraft name UBAKUSAT

Launched 2018-04-02

Deployer J-SSOD (JEM Small Satellite Orbital Deployer)

Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2018-05-11
Entity name ITU (Istanbul Technical University)

Launch brokerer JAXA
Oneliner

Amateur radio communications and telemetry transmission.
Description

Provide voice communication between suitable locations from Low Earth Orbit for duration of about 10 minutes max. Secondary payload namely TAMSAT Simplesat card will also send the telemetry data about the simplesat conditions and the relative radiation data absorbed by the card to the ground station.
Notes

Deployed from ISS on 2018-05-11. New doppler measurements confirm again that UBAKUSAT is object 43467, 1KUNS-PF is object 43466 and SNUSAT 1B is object 42727. So the SatCat is not correct.
